info.title: AXON LunarSight API
info.description:
NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 — Lunar landing site evaluation model.

Calculates lunar surface topocentric geometry, 3D LOLA DEM terrain horizon skylines, photovoltaic solar generation proxies, and direct-to-Earth (DTE) communication visibility.

BodyOpportunitySchema.title: BodyOpportunitySchema
BodyOpportunitySchema.description:
Visibility summary for the Sun, Earth, or their joint intersection.

``sun`` and ``earth`` report ``longest_dark_gap_hours``; ``joint`` reports
``longest_joint_gap_hours``. Both keys are optional so neither body summary
is rejected or silently stripped. Both ``window_count`` and ``windows_count``
are retained for backwards compatibility.
